C1522.title: Euler Finance Hacker Receives On-Chain Phishing Message to Create Confusion
C1522.summary: On March 22, 2023, the Euler Finance attacker sent 100 ETH to the Ronin hacker to create confusion after the exploit. The Ronin hacker responded with 2 ETH and an on-chain message requesting decryption of an encrypted message. Security experts identified the message as a phishing scam attempting to steal the Euler attacker's wallet private key.
